reason: The thought of an AI giving a customer the wrong price or treatment information worries me, and I'd end up checking every answer myself. My front desk already picks up the phone, and the website is an afterthought, so I don't see the need yet.
objection: What if the AI gives a patient or customer wrong information?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it answer real questions from my own price list correctly during the free trial, and hand the tricky ones to my staff.
